project_info.title: Champagne silk dress by the suite window

prompt.main_subject: An adult Asian woman with long wavy hair wearing the specified champagne silk slip dress, standing in a luxury suite before a floor-to-ceiling night view.
prompt.composition_elements: First-person perspective begins behind the woman at the window, then follows her turn toward camera, approach beside the sofa, and barefoot steps across the soft carpet.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm ambient suite lighting, brilliant city night view, ambiguous cinematic light, and luxurious high-definition texture.

technical_specs.camera: First-person follow with a gentle pan down toward the carpet and feet while preserving a respectful fashion framing.
technical_specs.motion: Slow turn, walk toward camera, fingers lightly graze sofa back, then barefoot steps.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic photorealistic vertical first-person video inside a luxury suite with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a brilliant city night view and soft warm ambient lighting. An adult Asian woman with long wavy hair wears the specified champagne silk slip dress. She stands with her back to the camera looking at the night view, then slowly turns upon hearing a sound with a composed faint smile and says, "The night view is beautiful, isn't it?" She walks slowly toward the camera, fingers lightly grazing the back of the sofa. The camera follows her movement and pans down respectfully to show barefoot steps on the soft carpet with nude nail polish. Use ambiguous cinematic lighting, luxurious texture, and high-definition image quality without suggestive framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, seductive dialogue, minor, watermark, text, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
